This is usually [[ISO 843|transliterated letter-for-letter]] back into the [[Latin alphabet]] as ''Antetokounmpo''.}} 27 August 2001) is a Nigerian–Greek professional [[basketball]] player for [[Promitheas Patras B.C.|Promitheas Patras]] of the [[Greek Basket League]] (GBL) and the [[Basketball Champions League]] (BCL). He is the youngest brother of basketball players [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]], [[Thanasis Antetokounmpo|Thanasis]], and [[Kostas Antetokounmpo|Kostas]]. ==Early life== Antetokounmpo was born in [[Sepolia]], a neighbourhood in [[Athens]], Greece, as the son of Nigerian parents Veronica and Charles Antetokounmpo. He has a Nigerian passport, which he received in June 2013, so that he could gain a [[visa policy of the United States|visa]], and be allowed to legally enter into the [[United States]].[http://www.gazzetta.gr/basketball/article/916698/i-halasmeni-kafetiera gazzetta.gr Η χαλασμένη LLP καφετιέρα {{in lang|el}}.] He received Greek citizenship in September 2021, alongside his mother. [https://greekcitytimes.com/2021/09/17/antetokounmpos-greek-citizenship/amp/ Greek City Times {{in lang|en}}.] He started playing basketball at age nine,{{cite web |last1=Fader |first1=Mirin |title=The Rise of the Next Antetokounmpo |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2845193-the-rise-of-the-next-antetokounmpo |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=23 June 2020 |date=18 July 2019}} and in sixth grade, moved with his family to [[Cudahy, Wisconsin]], near where his older brother Giannis was practicing for his rookie season for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the (NBA) [[National Basketball Association]]. Before high school he moved to [[River Hills, Wisconsin]]. He attended Dominican High School in [[Whitefish Bay, Wisconsin]].{{cite web |last1=Hogg |first1=Curt |title=With help from his brother, Alex Antetokounmpo is taking on a 'killer' mentality and making a name for himself |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/high-schools/2018/12/27/alex-antetokounmpo-younger-brother-giannis-makes-name-himself/2366906002/ |website=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |accessdate=22 June 2020 |date=26 December 2018}} ==High school career== Antetokounmpo played basketball for [[Dominican High School (Whitefish Bay, Wisconsin)|Dominican High School]] in Whitefish Bay for four years. As a freshman, he averaged 2.9 points per game, and grew about 12 cm (five inches) to {{height|m=2.03}} by the time he was a sophomore. Antetokounmpo was a two-time all-state selection and averaged 20 points and seven rebounds per game as a senior. He received scholarship offers from [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]], [[Ohio Bobcats men's basketball|Ohio]] and [[Green Bay Phoenix men's basketball|Green Bay]].{{cite news |title=Giannis Antetokounmpo's brother Alex to skip college, play in Europe |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/29157514/giannis-antetokounmpo-brother-alex-skip-college-play-europe |accessdate=22 June 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=10 May 2020}} On 9 May 2020, Antetokounmpo announced that he would play in Europe after graduating from high school, rather than playing [[college basketball]]. He was considered a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by major recruiting services.{{cite web |last1=Schuster |first1=Blake |title=Giannis' Brother Alex Says He Plans to Play in Europe After Graduating HS |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2890969-giannis-brother-alex-says-he-plans-to-play-in-europe-after-graduating-hs |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=22 June 2020 |date=9 May 2020}} ==Professional career== ===UCAM Murcia (2020–2021)=== On 22 June 2020, Antetokounmpo signed a three-year contract with [[UCAM Murcia CB|UCAM Murcia]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{cite web |title=El UCAM Murcia ficha a Alex Antetokounmpo |url=http://www.ucamdeportes.com/ucamcb/noticias/el-ucam-murcia-ficha-alex-antetokounmpo |publisher=[[UCAM Murcia CB]] |accessdate=22 June 2020 |language=Spanish |date=22 June 2020}} On 18 October, he made his debut for the club's [[reserve team]] in the [[Liga EBA]], recording 28 points and six rebounds, shooting 6-of-9 from three-point range, in an 83–69 win over SCD Carolinas.{{cite web |title=El primer show del hermano de Antetokounmpo con el UCAM Murcia: 28 puntos y victoria |url=https://www.gigantes.com/basket-feb/eba/el-primer-show-del-hermano-de-antetokounmpo-con-el-ucam-murcia-28-puntos-y-victoria/ |website=Gigantes del Basket |accessdate=18 October 2020 |language=Spanish |date=18 October 2020}} ===Raptors 905 (2021–2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Antetokounmpo joined the [[Sacramento Kings]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/nba-news/1233771/alex-antetokounmpo-to-join-the-kings-in-summer-league/|title=Alex Antetokounmpo to join the Kings in Summer League|website=Eurohoops.net|date=30 July 2021|access-date=17 August 2021}} The [[Sacramento Kings]] then proceeded to win the [[2021 NBA Summer League]]. On 14 October 2021, Antetokounmpo was signed to an Exhibit 10 contract by the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{Cite web|title=Raptors: Alex Antetokounmpo, Josh Hall to sign Exhibit 10 contracts|url=https://raptorsrapture.com/2021/10/14/raptors-alex-antetokounmpo-josh-hall-exhibit-10-contracts/|url-status=live|access-date=17 October 2021|website=Raptors Rapture|date=14 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211014161224/https://raptorsrapture.com/2021/10/14/raptors-alex-antetokounmpo-josh-hall-exhibit-10-contracts/ |archive-date=14 October 2021 }} However, he was waived the following day to join the [[Raptors 905]] as an affiliate player.{{Cite web|title=Toronto Raptors waive Alex Antetokounmpo and Josh Hall, both to join Raptors 905|url=https://ca.nba.com/news/toronto-raptors-waive-alex-antetokounmpo-josh-hall-raptors-905/1pdn8r3m3oyn11oaf7ygmfeoe0|url-status=live|access-date=17 October 2021|website=NBA|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211017230629/https://ca.nba.com/news/toronto-raptors-waive-alex-antetokounmpo-josh-hall-raptors-905/1pdn8r3m3oyn11oaf7ygmfeoe0 |archive-date=17 October 2021 }} ===Wisconsin Herd (2022–2024)=== On 3 November 2022, Antetokounmpo was named to the opening night roster for the [[Wisconsin Herd]] in the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|title=Wisconsin Herd Announces 2022-23 Opening Day Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/wisconsin-herd-announces-2022-23-opening-day-roster/n-5895537|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=3 November 2022|access-date=3 November 2022}} On 31 August 2023, Antetokounmpo signed with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]], but was waived the same day{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Bucks Sign Drew Timme; Sign, Waive Alex Antetokounmpo|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/09/bucks-sign-alex-antetokounmpo-drew-timme.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=2 September 2023|access-date=2 September 2023}} and on 30 October, he rejoined Wisconsin.{{cite web|title=Wisconsin Herd Announce 2023 Training Camp Roster|url=https://wisconsin.gleague.nba.com/news/wisconsin-herd-announce-2023-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=30 October 2023|access-date=23 January 2024}}{{cite web|first=Jim|last=Owczarski|title=Drew Timme, Alex Antetokounmpo, Glenn Robinson III headline the Wisconsin Herd camp roster|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/nba/bucks/2023/10/30/wisconsin-herd-training-camp-roster-drew-timme-alex-antetokounmpo-glenn-robinson-iii/71382175007/|work=Milwaukee Journal Sentinel|date=30 October 2023|access-date=30 October 2023}} On 8 February 2024, he was waived by the Herd.{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Wisconsin Herd Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Wisconsin-Herd/50/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=10 February 2024}} ===Mažeikiai (2024)=== On 13 February 2024, Antetokounmpo signed with [[BC Mažeikiai|M Basket-Delamode Mažeikiai]] of the [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]].{{cite web|title=A. Antetokounmpo iš NBA G lygos keliasi į Mažeikius|url=https://www.mbasket.lt/aantetokounmpo|website=MBasket.lt|date=13 February 2024|access-date=15 February 2024|language=Lithuanian}} ===Podgorica (2024)=== On 17 August 2024, Antetokounmpo signed with [[KK Podgorica|Podgorica]] of the [[Prva A Liga]] and the [[ABA League|ABA League 2]],{{Cite web |title=Aleks Adetokunbo potpisao za Podgoricu |url=https://www.vijesti.me/sport/kosarka/720251/aleks-adetokunbo-potpisao-za-podgoricu |access-date=2024-08-17 |website=vijesti.me |language=sr}} eventually playing only five games for the Montenegrin club.{{cite web | title=Adetokunbo left Podgorica and moved to PAOK | website=vijesti.me | date=2024-10-23 | url=https://en.vijesti.me/sports-e/basketball/729484/adetokunbo-left-podgorica-and-moved-to-paok | access-date=2025-06-13}} ===PAOK (2024–2025)=== On 22 October 2024, Antetokounmpo signed with [[PAOK BC|PAOK]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]].{{cite web |title=Alex Antetokounmpo signs with PAOK in Greece |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba/fiba-europe-cup-en/1731907/alex-antetokounmpo-signs-with-paok-in-greece/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=22 October 2024 |language=en |date=22 October 2024}} On 31 July 2025, he renewed his contract with the [[FIBA Europe Cup]] finalists. On 13 August of the same year, however, Antetokounmpo requested to be released from the club. ===Aris (2025)=== On 15 August 2025, Antetokounmpo signed a two-year contract with [[Aris B.C.|Aris]]. However, he appeared in only two official games with the club. ===Milwaukee Bucks / Wisconsin Herd (2025–2026)=== On 13 October 2025, Antetokounmpo signed a two-way contract with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]], marking the first time in [[NBA]] franchise history that three brothers — [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]], [[Thanasis Antetokounmpo|Thanasis]], and Alex— played on the same team.{{cite web |date=October 13, 2025 |title=Bucks signing third Antetokounmpo brother, Alex |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/report-bucks-signing-third-antetokounmpo-brother-alex--flm-2025-10-13 |work=Reuters}} On 31 March 2026, Antetokounmpo made his NBA and Bucks debut, putting up 3 points in a 123–99 win over the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/milwaukee-bucks/bucks-news-kyle-kuzmas-heartfelt-reaction-to-Alex-antetokounmpos-nba-debut|title=Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma’s heartfelt reaction to Alex Antetokounmpo’s NBA debut|website=ClutchPoints|last=Pagaduan|first=Jedd|date=March 31, 2026|access-date=April 1, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/nba-news/1950868/giannis-on-alexs-debut-now-i-can-retire/|title=Giannis on Alex’s debut: “Now I can retire”|website=Eurohoops|date=April 1, 2026|access-date=April 1, 2026}}. Including that debut, he played in 6 of the Bucks' final 8 games of the season. ===Promitheas Patras (2026–present)=== On 27 June 2026, Greek basketball club [[Promitheas Patras B.C.]] announced that Antetokounmpo would be joining the team for the upcoming season.{{cite web |last1=Owczarski |first1=Jim |title=Giannis’ youngest brother, Alex Antetokounmpo, signs with Greek team |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/alex-antetokounmpo-signs-greek-team-173502968.html |website=Milwaukee Journal Sentinel |publisher=USA Today |access-date=8 July 2026}}{{cite web |title=Alex Antetokounmpo is a resident of Patras |url=https://promitheasbc.gr/katoikos-patron-o-aleks-antetokounmpo/ |website=KAE Promitheas Patras |access-date=8 July 2026 |language=el |date=27 June 2026}} As of 8 July, however, he is also still listed on the Milwaukee Bucks' roster, and no departure announcement has been made.{{cite web |title=Roster {{!}} Milwaukee Bucks |url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/roster |access-date=8 July 2026}} ==Personal life== [[File:Antetokounmpo Brothers (cropped).jpg|thumb|right|The Antetokounmpo brothers participating in the [[2022 NBA All-Star Game#Skills Challenge|2022 NBA All-Star Skills Challenge]]]] Three of his older brothers, [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]], [[Thanasis Antetokounmpo|Thanasis]] and [[Kostas Antetokounmpo|Kostas]], play basketball professionally, and all three have won NBA championships. Giannis was named [[NBA Most Valuable Player Award|NBA Most Valuable Player]] in both 2019 and 2020. Thanasis and Giannis won the NBA championship in 2021 with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]], where Giannis was also named [[NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award|Finals MVP]]. Kostas last played for the [[Chicago Bulls]] and won an NBA title with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] in 2020. In 2025, Alex joined the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] on a two-way contract, becoming teammates with Giannis and Thanasis.{{cite web |title=Bucks sign third Antetokounmpo brother Alex |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/report-bucks-signing-third-antetokounmpo-brother-alex--flm-2025-10-13/ |website=Reuters |date=October 13, 2025 |access-date=October 16, 2025}} Antetokounmpo's father, Charles, and his oldest brother, Francis, played [[association football|soccer]] in Nigeria. His mother, Veronica, was a [[high jump]]er.{{cite web |date=26 September 2013 |title=NBA Rookie Wants To Bring Hope To Greece, And To Milwaukee |url=https://www.npr.org/2013/09/26/226268651/nbas-g-bo-wants-to-bring-hope-to-greece-and-to-milwaukee |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160423082144/http://www.npr.org/2013/09/26/226268651/nbas-g-bo-wants-to-bring-hope-to-greece-and-to-milwaukee |archive-date=23 April 2016 |accessdate=9 April 2016 |work=NPR.com}} In September 2021, Alex and his mother were granted honorary [[Greek nationality law|Greek citizenship]] by the [[Prime Minister of Greece]], [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]].{{Cite web |title=Giannis Antetokounmpo's mother and brother granted honorary Greek citizenship {{!}} eKathimerini.com |url=https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1168010/giannis-antetokounmpo-s-mother-and-brother-granted-honorary-greek-citizenship/ |access-date=17 September 2021 |website=www.ekathimerini.com |language=English}} Alex, hockey player [[Filip Forsberg]], and three of his older brothers — Giannis, Thanasis, and Kostas — were also announced as part of the [[Nashville SC]] ownership group in [[Major League Soccer|MLS]].{{cite tweet |author=Major League Soccer |author-link=Major League Soccer |user=MLS |number=1631295244565204993 |date=2 March 2023 |title=Filip Forsberg 🏒 Giannis 🏀 Thanasis 🏀 Kostas 🏀 Alex 🏀 All joining the @NashvilleSC ownership group. Welcome to MLS! https://t.co/FI1tnWb36Y |language=en |access-date=12 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230302154219/https://twitter.com/MLS/status/1631295244565204993 |archive-date=2 March 2023 |url-status=live}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2025}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2025–26 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee]] | 6 || 0 || 3.5 || .375 || .286 || .733 || 1.0 || .2 || .0 || .2 || 3.2 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 6 || 0 || 3.5 || .375 || .286 || .733 || 1.0 || .2 || .0 || .2 || 3.2 {{S-end}} ==Notes== {{notelist}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Antetokounmpo, Alex}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century Greek sportsmen]] [[Category:Antetokounmpo family]] [[Category:Aris B.C. players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Athens]] [[Category:CB Murcia players]] [[Category:Greek expatriate basketball people in Canada]] [[Category:Greek expatriate basketball people in Lithuania]] [[Category:Greek expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Greek expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Greek men's basketball players]] [[Category:Greek people of Igbo descent]] [[Category:Greek people of Nigerian descent]] [[Category:Greek people of Yoruba descent]] [[Category:Igbo sportspeople]] [[Category:KK Podgorica players]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:Milwaukee Bucks players]] [[Category:Naturalized citizens of Greece]] [[Category:NBA players from Greece]] [[Category:P.A.O.K.
